about: Queries main's slash matcher matched to NOTHING, for the differential guard (slash-differential.test.ts). The queries (slash-differential-queries.ts) are single words: each base (every block's internal name and each of main's keywords, lower-cased) with one punctuation character inserted at each position, plus each punctuation character alone and doubled. noMatch[base][char] lists the insert positions main matched to nothing; '*' means every position. alone lists the punctuation-only queries main matched to nothing.
